default.description: The window's own commands: its theme, its material, its maximize button, its first frame, its title and its taskbar button.

permission.description: The page tells the window its theme.
The page asks the window which theme it keeps.
The page asks the window what it was built of and what the next start builds.
The page tells the window which material the person chose, for the next start.
The page tells the window where its maximize button is.
The page tells the window it has drawn its first frame.
The page tells the window its title and the progress of its taskbar button.
